image_description: A Roseate Spoonbill standing in rippling blue water. The bird has predominantly white plumage on its head, neck, and chest, transitioning to vibrant pink feathers on its wings and back. It features a long, flat, spatulate bill that is pale greyish-yellow. The legs are partially submerged but appear dark. The water reflects the pink hues of the bird.
